scaling: per sample: x = log2(TPM + 1) over the frozen genes present; z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x), mean and population sd (ddof=0) over that sample's genes only (pre-registration 2.2 item 9(d)); similarity = Pearson correlation with each centroid over the same genes

meta.label_source: Brennan et al. 2013 (Cell 155:462), Molecular_subtype_classification.xlsx, column 'Cluster'; four Verhaak classes only (G-CIMP and NA not used)
meta.label_provenance: mixed: 202 samples of Verhaak et al. 2010 carry the labels of its consensus hierarchical clustering; the other 342 were assigned by a single-sample GSEA classifier (Brennan 2013). Flag: verhaak2010_included
meta.scoring_population: cohort patients with an expression sample

MATR3.rule: highest mean log2(TPM+1) over the v2 training patients

meta.use: every labelled TCGA patient; reserved for T1
